End of a season for one tag cohort: ageing and recaptures

Source: R/model_obs_tagging.R
end_tag_cohort_season.Rd

Survival (under move_timing = 0, after movement), the shift to the next season or the next year and age, the state-space numbers at age factor, and the predicted recaptures. A season the cohort is at liberty for none of (conv_tag_t_tagging = 0 at release) has no recaptures.

Usage

end_tag_cohort_season(
  avail_tc,
  recap_tc,
  seas_vals,
  tag_step,
  tag_int,
  y,
  rseas,
  n_seas,
  reporting_y,
  NAA_scalar,
  move_timing,
  n_pop,
  n_regions,
  n_ages,
  n_sexes,
  n_fish_fleets
)

Arguments

avail_tc, recap_tc

Arrays of the cohort's tags [liberty + 1, season, pop, region, age, sex] and predicted recaptures [liberty, season, pop, region, age, sex, fish_fleet].

seas_vals

The cohort's seas_vals from start_tag_cohort_season.

tag_step, tag_int

The cohort's tags at the end of the season and integrated over it, from move_tag_cohorts (NULL under move_timing = 0).

y, rseas, n_seas

Year, season and number of seasons.

reporting_y

Array [region, fish_fleet] of tag reporting rates in year y.

NAA_scalar

Array [pop, region, year, season, age, sex] of the state-space numbers at age factor, or NULL.

move_timing

Where movement sits relative to mortality (0, 1 or 2).

n_pop, n_regions, n_ages, n_sexes, n_fish_fleets

Dimension sizes.

Value

List with avail_tc and recap_tc.
